title: Professional native-first synthesis and DSP
scope: Synthesizer sound generation, DSP fidelity, quality qualification and cross-host rendering; complements docs/song-rollout.md instead of replacing its Song-specific stages.
mission: Deliver professionally viable editable instruments that sound correct in native desktop/mobile production and natively in pre-programmed, while retaining a compatible web studio wherever technically feasible.

platform_policy.professional_quality_gate: native reference implementations must pass acoustic and CPU benchmarks even if web support requires an explicit degraded mode
platform_policy.portability: portable patch/automation/event semantics with host-specific DSP implementations verified by reference fixtures
platform_policy.real_time: avoid allocation, blocking I/O, locks and GC-sensitive work in audio callback

milestones.contract: Top-level delayTone 20..20000 Hz (20000 bypasses tone), delayPingPong boolean; existing delay send/mix/time/feedback remain. Feedback one-pole alpha=1-exp(-2*pi*f/rate), then channel swap for ping-pong. Wet output remains separately owned for stop/live-vocal crossfade. Complete echo intervals match native/Web instead of adding 128 native frames per repeat.

Shared stereo width (0..2) and mid/side balance (-1..1) implemented before pan after source downmix, with graph and ordinary controls. M=(L+R)/2, S=(L-R)/2; positive balance attenuates M, negative attenuates S, width scales S. Neutral is transparent; width preserves mono, side-only intentionally silences mono. Per-channel bound <=2 times bounded input peak at width=2; no automatic limiter. Mono sum cancels S. Shaper alternatives, noise colors and matched listening/headroom qualification remain open.

EQ supports 0..8 bands with stable IDs, independent add/remove, shared graph/dials and chain lifecycle. Four default disabled bands remain the starting point; fixed eight native states pad unused bands with unity coefficients. The single Sound Inspector mounts these editors for synth, sampled Sound and vocal; combined view follows the new control links.
